'''Firefist''',<ref name="Unknown regions">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> also known as '''Companion Besh''', was a dwarf [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] in a close and decaying [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic disk]] which was 150,000 [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]] from it. Firefist contained the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworlds]] of the [[Faruun]], [[Maccabree]], [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] and [[Tof/Legends|Tof]] [[Species/Legends|species]], and was considered unexplored, as only [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] visited it.<ref name="TEA" />

Companion Besh was seen on a galaxy map accessed by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] shortly before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist alliance]].<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The second satellite [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] appears in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="AOTC" /> but was not given a formal name until the publication of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'',<ref name="TEA" /> and then a colloquial name in ''[[The Unknown Regions]]''.<ref name="Unknown regions" />
